source_objectives.info: External Temperature is displayed in the top right. Use shelter, campfires & heaters to increase temperature.

source_objectives.text: Setup Oxygen - Build any Oxite Dissolver
Setup Water - Melt Ice in a Rain Reservoir
Defeat a Frostfoot with your Gribbler
Defeat the Roaming Frostfoot with your Gribbler (map marker)
source_objectives.info: The Gribbler must get some attacks on the Frostfoot to complete. The Frostfoot will respawn in 5 minutes if you fail.

source_objectives.text: Travel to the Quarry in the Tundra (map marker)

source_objectives.info: Take your Gribbler with you as you fight, craft and explore to level it
Snare Traps and Gribbler Bait can be unlocked and crafted on the Ranching Station at T2
Bananas can be found around Water in the Desert. Super Cooled Ice can be obtained by smashing breakable rocks in the Arctic.

source_objectives.text: Wait for the Trapped Gribbler to Pacify ({0}%)
source_objectives.info: Drop Carcasses Near the Gribbler to Feed it. Stay out of Sight and Clear the Area of Threats Near the Gribbler to Keep it Calm

source_objectives.text: Bait the Snare Trap with the Gribbler Bait
source_objectives.info: Focus the Bait in your Quickbar and Interact with the Snare Trap

source_objectives.text: Deploy the Snare trap in the Tundra
Wait for the Snare Trap to Catch a Gribbler
source_objectives.info: This may take a while... If you find a Gribbler, lead them over the trap to capture.
